verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The note proves an explicit counterexample to Saco's v1 theorem and restores normality only after imposing an early-measurable suffix-QV condition that directly assumes relative predictable-QV stabilization. It does not characterize validity on Saco's published variance-growth class, so the framing of an "inference frontier" or exact temporal boundary overstates a sufficient condition plus one violating witness. The finite-attractor mixed-normal and pivotality results assume finite tail selection and a vanishing uniform Cesaro-attraction modulus; these load-bearing dynamics are not established for the Guo--Xu recursion, and the HeartSteps discussion is only a consumer interpretation. The deterministic-sandwich iff statements are conditional scale-mixture identification and polarization results, leaving the unverified recursion-to-class bridge as the specific obstacle to field tier.

DIRECTED IMPROVEMENT (re-derive the SAME object implementing this, do not reproduce the prior note): Prove that switching-layer occupation in the exact Guo--Xu recursion is asymptotically negligible and derive explicit compact-initial-set sequences r_T(K_0), delta_T(K_0) tending to zero; then verify finite-attractor-class membership and instantiate Theorems 1--2.
